title: Cross-functional acceptance grooming for staged-scope reduction and legal checkpoints
creator: Sasha Kim
description: This ticket centralizes the cross-team grooming needed to finalize acceptance criteria for a PRD that proposes a staged scope reduction by feature flag. The PRD introduces conditional UX flows, a lightweight server-side fallback, and policy checks that may trigger legal export-control review for certain telemetry and model artifacts. We must: 1) agree exact handoff responsibilities between Product, Engineering, and Design for each stage; 2) define deterministic acceptance criteria (build + test + smoke + metrics) per stage; 3) capture legal gating conditions and required artifacts for export/privacy review; and 4) produce a short operational playbook for rollbacks and canary thresholds. This ticket coordinates the interlock meetings, collects signoffs, and surfaces any open questions that block release of the staged rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Documented owner for each staged scope increment (stage-0..stage-3) with contact and escalation path
Per-stage pass/fail checklist: automated tests, UX smoke test, latency regression <5%, error budget burn <10% during canary
Legal checklist completed or scoped mitigation defined for export-control flags (link to legal artifact)
Design handoff artifacts uploaded (Figma frames + interaction notes) and verified in a brief design QA session
Engineering provides an implementation plan including feature-flag gating logic, metrics to track, and rollback steps
A single-line runbook exists in Confluence with step-by-step rollback and postmortem triggers
